title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson was back practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Hendrickson began the week missing practice on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Saquon Barkley (stinger) without update per HC Nick Sirianni
items.desc: Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni did not have an update on the status of Saquon Barkley on Thursday.
items.impact: The Eagles injury report will be released later in the afternoon. Tank Bigsby is worth stashing for now for fantasy managers just in case with Barkley.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Ramsey (rest) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Jalen Ramsey was back practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Ramsey was back after getting a rest day at practice to begin the week on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jamel Dean (ankle) back at practice Thursday
items.desc: Jamel Dean returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Dean opened the week missing practice on Wednesday. He'll need to be monitored in practice again on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. practices Thursday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. logged a second straight practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Porter is continuing to work on getting his conditioning back. He could be on the field for the Steelers on Sunday with another practice on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Dowdle was seen in a boot during practice on Wednesday. He is likely to be ruled out this week. Jaylen Warren should enter Sunday's game in a clear lead role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Warren (shoulder) practices Thursday
items.desc: Jaylen Warren was in uniform and participating in the period open to the media on Thursday.
items.impact: Rico Dowdle missed another practice. Warren is trending towards being the clear lead back on Sunday against the Bengals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Frankie Luvu (groin) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Frankie Luvu was not seen at the start of practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Luvu is trending towards remaining sidelined for the Commanders on Sunday unless he can return to practice in some capacity on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo was not seen at the start of practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Okonkwo continues to work his way back from a hamstring injury. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to return on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Cosmi (concussion) not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Sam Cosmi was not seen at the start of practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Cosmi remains on track to be sidelined this weekend after being placed in concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trent Brown (knee/wrist) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Trent Brown was back practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Brown missed practice on Wednesday to begin the week. His return on Thursday puts him on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadeveon Clowney (knee) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Jadeveon Clowney did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Clowney missed a second straight practice to begin the week. He'll likely need to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a good chance of playing on Sunday against the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ed Ingram (groin) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Ed Ingram did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It is a second straight absence from practice for Ingram to begin the week. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nico Collins (hamstring) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Nico Collins remained absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Collins continues to trend towards missing a second straight game due to a hamstring injury. His status will still need to be monitored on Friday to end the practice week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Branson Combs not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Jaguars LB Branson Combs was not seen at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Combs was not on the injury report on Wednesday. His status will need to be monitored when Thursday's injury report is released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dalton Schultz (rest) back at practice Thursday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: After a huge performance on Sunday, Schultz received a rest day to begin the practice week. If Nico Collins remains sidelined, he'll be in line for TE1 volume once again.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Javon Kinlaw (shoulder) practices Thursday
items.desc: Commanders DL Javon Kinlaw was practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Kinlaw is managing a shoulder injury. He'll have a chance to be good to go for a depleted Commanders defense with another practice on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield (illness) practices Thursday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield remained practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Despite landing on the injury report with an illness, Mayfield remains on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rueben Bain Jr. (groin) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Rueben Bain Jr. did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It is the second straight absence from practice to begin the week for Bain. He'll have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance of playing this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Nelson (shin) practices Thursday
items.desc: Anthony Nelson returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Nelson opened the week missing practice on Wednesday. It is a step in the right direction to play this week if he can log another practice on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josiah Trotter (shoulder) practices Thursday
items.desc: Josiah Trotter practiced on Thursday.
items.impact: Trotter was seen working out on the side during practice on Wednesday. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Friday to end the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Luke Basso released by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins released long snapper Luke Basso from the practice squad.
items.impact: Miami signed WR AJ Henning as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: AJ Henning signs with Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins signed WR AJ Henning to their practice squad.
items.impact: Henning will add depth in the wide receiver room for Miami. Luke Basso was released as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Puka Nacua (hip) not making 'great progress'
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Puka Nacua is "not making progress."
items.impact: McVay made the comment to ESPN Los Angeles. Nacua appears likely to miss a second straight game due to the injury. Davante Adams and Terrance Ferguson will both see more more opportunity if he misses another game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rodney Thomas II signs with Seahawks active roster
items.desc: The Seahawks are signing safety Rodney Thomas II off their practice squad to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Thomas has started the first two games with Ty Okada hurt. He had one more practice squad elevation.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Austin Johnson signs with Bills
items.desc: The Bills signed DL Austin Johnson to the team's practice squad.
items.impact: Johnson will add depth on the defensive line for Buffalo.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Liam Anderson signs with Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins signed ILB Liam Anderson to the practice squad.
items.impact: Anderson will add depth in the linebacker room for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Myarick reverts back to Raiders practice squad
items.desc: Chris Myarick reverted back to the Raiders practice squad.
items.impact: Myriack could see another opportunity soon.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cody White reverts back to Raiders practice squad
items.desc: Cody White reverted back to the Raiders practice squad.
items.impact: White caught two touchdowns last week. He could be elevated again soon.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Mills signs with Lions practice squad
items.desc: The Lions signed DB Jalen Mills to their practice squad.
items.impact: Mills will add depth in the secondary for Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaxson Moi signs with Rams practice squad
items.desc: The Rams signed DT Jaxson Moi to their practice squad.
items.impact: Moi will add depth on the defensive line for the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keidron Smith signs with Bears practice squad
items.desc: The Bears signed DB Keidron Smith to their practice squad.
items.impact: Smith will add depth in the secondary for Chicago.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kole Wilson released by Browns
items.desc: The Browns released WR Kole Wilson.
items.impact: Wilson will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bryce Oliver signs with Texans practice squad
items.desc: The Texans signed WR Bryce Oliver to their practice squad.
items.impact: Oliver will add depth in the wide receiver room for Houston.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jerrick Reed II signs with Cardinals practice squad
items.desc: The Cardinals signed S Jerrick Reed II to their practice squad.
items.impact: Reed will add depth in the secondary for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marvin Jones Jr. signs with Commanders practice squad
items.desc: The Commanders signed LB Marvin Jones Jr. to their practice squad.
items.impact: Jones will add depth in the linebacker room for Washington.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Oliver (hip) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ed Oliver (hip) missed Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Oliver suffered this hip injury in pregame warmups last week. He was still sidelined at practice on Wednesday, and it looks like it may force him to miss another week. His absence this weekend would be less than ideal for the Bills ahead of a competitive matchup against the Chargers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ty Johnson (hamstring) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Ty Johnson (hamstring) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran running back seems very close to a return to the field, as he was able to practice in full on Wednesday after being sidelined for last week's game. He is trending towards playing in Week 3, but his potential return would be unlikely to have a substantial impact on Buffalo's backfield moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keon Coleman (ankle) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Keon Coleman (ankle) did not take part in Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The young wideout is now recovering from an ankle injury and may miss Sunday's game because of it. If he is ruled out ahead of game time, look for Khalil Shakir and Dalton Kincaid to be two of the main beneficiaries of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) was officially limited in Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Moore suffered a shoulder injury during last week's win over the Lions. He is considered day-to-day for now and was able to practice on Wednesday in a limited fashion. He may be ready to play in time for Week 3, but we likely won't know his official status until the end of the practice week on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alaric Jackson (knee) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Alaric Jackson (knee) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Los Angeles' starting left tackle is dealing with an injury right now. Alaric was limited at Wednesday's walk-through due to a knee issue, but it's still early in the week and he may very well be cleared to play prior to Week 3. His potential absence would be bad news for the Rams ahead of a tough matchup against Denver's elite defensive front, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Ferguson was estimated to be a limited participant at Wednesday's walk-through for the Rams. He's managing an ankle injury right now, but it doesn't seem to be more than a minor issue for him at this point. Fantasy managers should keep tabs on updates about his health and about the health of Puka Nacua (hip), as the young tight end benefited greatly when Los Angeles was missing their star wideout last week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Colby Parkinson (knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson (knee) missed Los Angeles' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was held out of practice due to a knee injury on Wednesday. We won't know if there's much substance to this injury until later on in the week, but Terrance Ferguson (ankle) will see more work if Parkinson has to miss any time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kinchens was not able to partake in Wednesday's walk-through due to a hamstring issue. If it forces him to miss time, Los Angeles' secondary will look weaker than usual in a matchup against the Broncos this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) was absent from Los Angeles' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Robinson wasn't able to practice on Wednesday, which comes as no surprise considering that the 49ers are contemplating whether or not to place him on injured reserve. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to play a role on this offense for the next couple of weeks at least.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian McCaffrey (rest) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey (rest) did not take part in San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McCaffrey was given Wednesday off as a veteran rest day, which is normal for him at the first practice of the week. He should be a full go for Sunday's game and remains a must-start fantasy option in all league formats for as long as he stays healthy and on the field.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylin Lane (groin) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Jaylin Lane (groin) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The young wideout is still listed on Washington's injury report due to a nagging groin issue, but he was able to play through it last week and should be able to do the same again in Week 3. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.
